frequency_question: What proportion of 3-month observation windows in emerging market monetary policy cycles contain at least one policy rate hike?
membership_rule: Includes any standard monetary policy committee review cycle of 3 months for major emerging market central banks (e.g., RBI, Bank Indonesia, Banco Central do Brasil, South African Reserve Bank) from 2005 to 2024 where the prior trend was not aggressively easing. Excludes emergency inter-meeting moves and periods of strict pegging.
coverage_note: 12 named representative windows; believed roughly 40 in total across broader emerging markets for this specific phase, maintaining a similar ratio.
known_gaps: Does not account for idiosyncratic domestic political pressures or unique commodity price shocks of specific quarters.
skeleton: 12 named cases across representative emerging market central bank tightening/pause phases
validity_reason: Central bank reaction functions and macroeconomic structures evolve over long horizons, but structural inflation dynamics across emerging markets remain stable over a 5-year span.
